name: sfx_katana_slash_01
text: A fast sharp katana sword swing whoosh through the air with a bright metallic energy edge, neon cyberpunk blade, clean and crisp, no impact.

name: sfx_shuriken_throw_01
text: A small spinning metal throwing star thrown hard, a quick high whirring whoosh flying away, light and fast.

name: sfx_explosion_01
text: A punchy compact explosion with an electric synth crackle, a sci-fi neon grenade blast with a short tail.

name: sfx_slam_01
text: A huge heavy fat man slamming both armoured fists into a stone floor, a deep bass ground impact with rumble and falling debris, extremely powerful.

name: sfx_dash_01
text: A very fast air dash whoosh, a quick blink swoosh with a slight synth shimmer.

name: sfx_parry_01
text: A crisp metallic sword parry clang deflecting a projectile, a bright ringing ping with an electric shimmer.

name: sfx_ultimate_01
text: A charged energy sword special attack: a short rising synth whine, then a massive slicing laser slash across a whole arena, cinematic.

name: sfx_boss_hit_01
text: A heavy blow landing on a big fat man in armour, a dull meaty thud with a metallic armour clink.

name: sfx_hero_hurt_01
text: A young warrior's short pained grunt as he is hit, with a sharp electric zap.

name: sfx_steal_card_01
text: A dramatic game menu stinger: a paper card slapped down on a desk with a short tense synth hit.

name: sfx_steal_01
text: A glitchy digital tearing sound, a feature being ripped out of a video game, data corruption glitch with a downward pitch drop.

name: sfx_everything_back_01
text: A triumphant rising synth swell with sparkling glitter, power restored, everything coming back online, bright and uplifting.

name: sfx_final_blow_01
text: A final decisive katana strike: an enormous slicing impact with a deep boom and a long shimmering metallic ring-out, a victory moment.

name: sfx_ultimate_ready_01
text: A short bright rising synth chime, a power-up ready notification, three quick ascending notes, clean game interface sound.

name: sfx_heal_cash_01
text: A cash register ka-ching: a quick mechanical drawer slide and a bright bell ding with a coin jingle, a satisfying money pickup in an arcade game.

name: mus_poc_loop
text: A bare unfinished prototype game music loop at 120 BPM: only a dry metronome click on every beat and a thin square-wave bass note, lo-fi placeholder, no melody.
